note: Trade-checker numbers (docs/LEAGUE_RULES_MODEL.md, 'Trades' and 'Salary cap application'; owner decisions in docs/GOVERNANCE_ROADMAP.md). scripts/trade_checker.py is the source of truth; index.html carries a thin port that is tested against it. The tool flags what a trade cannot do; it never says a trade is good or fair.

cooldown.rankSource: oRank in data/yahoo/player_registry.json (the preseason Yahoo O-Rank)
cooldown.note: Counted from the recorded effectiveAt of the trade that brought the player to his current team. Ledger dates are report dates, not Yahoo timestamps, so a countdown is 'from the recorded date'.

capLadder.under: Under 5 outside the band: trade-restricted for 2 weeks, and a repeat adds a 3-point allowance penalty.
capLadder.over: Over 5 outside the band: trade-restricted for 1 month, and a repeat adds a 5-point allowance penalty.
capLadder.exactly: Exactly 5 outside the band: the commissioner decides which step applies.
capLadder.nearDeadline: Near the trade deadline the restriction extends through next season's draft regardless of size (deadline date not yet set).
capLadder.note: Displayed only. The tool keeps no memory of past violations; the commissioner tracks restrictions.

roster.source: docs/LEAGUE_RULES_MODEL.md: 9 keepers, 15 total roster spots. Yahoo makes a team over the limit drop players when a trade is processed.
